storyCards.headline: Whenever I Call You Friend: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Kenny Loggins's "Whenever I Call You Friend" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Whenever I Call You Friend was released in 1978.

"Whenever I Call You Friend" by Kenny Loggins.

Chart story — peaked at #5 on the Hot 100.
